name: FalconBeat — synced show audio for phones
author: GraphicHealer
description: Plays your show's audio on visitors' phones in sync with the sequence: pushes playlist audio to a self-hosted BeatSync server and issues scheduled PLAY/PAUSE over its admin socket.

privacy.summary: Sends your show audio files and play/pause commands to the BeatSync server address you configure, so visitors' phones can play the show audio in sync.

sends.what: show audio files, playback commands, room admin secret
sends.why: lets visitors' phones stream the show audio in sync with the lights

systemChanges.what: runs a background Python daemon (falconbeatd) while fppd is running; listens only on a local unix socket
